title: withkynam/vibecode-pro-max-kit
claim: withkynam/vibecode-pro-max-kit — Your AI forgets. This remembers. Spec-driven coding harness for vibecoders, product owners, CEOs and real builders — sel
why_good: A spec-driven coding harness that gives 'vibecoders' and non-devs persistent context — rides the vibe-coding wave with a memory hook.
value: Prosumer subscription/template pack for non-technical builders using AI to ship; the wedge is persistent spec + context.
risk: Harness/prompt-kit with a thin moat; the agent tools add spec/memory natively, and 'vibecoder' retention is unproven.

zh.claim: withkynam/vibecode-pro-max-kit —— 你的 AI 会忘,这个记得住:面向 vibecoder、产品负责人、CEO 的规格驱动编码 harness。
zh.why_good: 一个规格驱动的编码 harness,给 vibecoder 和非开发者持续的上下文——踩在 vibe-coding 浪潮上,以记忆为钩子。
zh.value: 给用 AI 交付的非技术建造者卖专业订阅/模板包;切口是持续的规格 + 上下文。
zh.risk: harness/提示包护城河薄;agent 工具在原生加规格/记忆,而 vibecoder 留存未验证。
